debt_1960_adjusted = debt_1960 * (cpi_1962 / cpi_1960)

print(f"  FY 1961 adjusted: ${debt_1961_adjusted:,.3f}")

# Calculate absolute difference
difference = abs(debt_1961_adjusted - debt_1960_adjusted)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: ${difference:,.3f} million")
print(f"\nRounded to thousandths: {difference:.3f}")
EOF
